{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Filter out QC-failure rows (biomarker_baseline == -999)
df_filtered = df[df["biomarker_baseline"] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the highest sample_seq
# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq (descending) to ensure we keep the highest sample_seq
# Then drop duplicates on patient_id
df_dedup = df_filtered.sort_values(by=["patient_id", "sample_seq"], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset=["patient_id"], keep="first")

# Step 3: Compute the mean baseline biomarker value
mean_baseline = df_dedup["biomarker_baseline"].mean()

# Print the result
print(f'Mean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL): {mean_baseline}')"}
